text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Viral Hepatitis. The significantly elevated liver enzymes (AST > ALT) combined with direct hyperbilirubinemia, dark urine, and your history at the state fair are classic for hepatitis. The ultrasound was likely ordered to rule out gallstones, but the blood work points strongly to a viral etiology.
